import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
# Construct each demo exactly from its listed stripe clues and expected output rule.
# Pair 1: three anti-diagonal clue bands.
d1=[[0]*24 for _ in range(24)]
for r in range(24):
    for c in range(24):
        if r+c in (18,32): d1[r][c]=7
        elif r+c==43: d1[r][c]=4
o1=[[4 if (r+c)%3==1 else 7 for c in range(24)] for r in range(24)]
# Pair 2: six fully colored horizontal bands.
colors2=[3,5,8,4,7,2]
d2=[[x]*6 for x in colors2]; o2=[row[:] for row in d2]
# Pair 3: sampled rows from a six-row repeating sequence.
d3=[[0]*16 for _ in range(16)]
for r,color in {4:1,5:2,9:5,12:7,13:1,14:3}.items(): d3[r]=[color]*16
seq3=[7,1,3,5,1,2]
o3=[[seq3[r%6]]*16 for r in range(16)]
# Pair 4: five sampled consecutive rows of a five-row period.
d4=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,color in {10:3,11:3,12:8,13:4,14:5}.items(): d4[r]=[color]*15
seq4=[3,3,8,4,5]
o4=[[seq4[r%5]]*15 for r in range(15)]
for i,(di,oi) in enumerate([(d1,o1),(d2,o2),(d3,o3),(d4,o4)],1):
    pred=mod.transform(di)
    print(i, pred==oi, 'mismatches',sum(pred[r][c]!=oi[r][c] for r in range(len(oi)) for c in range(len(oi[0]))))
test=[[9,3],[0,9]]
print('test output:',mod.transform(test))
